data.description: The Leg Lift Post is a combination station around a single grey post. The product image shows an orange seat with footrests, a large orange wheel on the post and a separate round stool with a textured top beside it. On the seated part, users lift and lower the legs against the footrests. The wheel can be turned for the arms and shoulders, and the stool gives a place to sit or step. It suits older adults in a park or society who want gentle exercise in one spot. Its orange parts are listed as Play Orange. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. For the Leg Lift Post, we will confirm cover in writing; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

items.pText: The Leg Lift Post is a combination station around a single grey post. The product image shows an orange seat with footrests, a large orange wheel on the post and a separate round stool with a textured top beside it. On the seated part, users lift and lower the legs against the footrests. The wheel can be turned for the arms and shoulders, and the stool gives a place to sit or step. It suits older adults in a park or society who want gentle exercise in one spot. Its orange parts are listed as Play Orange. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. For the Leg Lift Post, we will confirm cover in writing; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

The seat arm and the wheel both turn on bearings, so check them at each service. The post and stool can be installed self-standing or grouted. Place the stool so it does not sit in the path of the moving seat arm, and keep the area level.
